name: GloGlo
long_description:
GloGlo is building a new consumer health brand for diabetics and the glucose-conscious.

Our first products are the GloGlo AI glucose companion, which turns continuous glucose data into personalized insights and practical guidance, and GloGlo Energy Gummies, a fast, convenient, and enjoyable source of glucose for exercise, daily energy, and managing lows.

We are starting with the Type 1 diabetes community, where glucose management is urgent and constant, before expanding to athletes and the broader metabolic health market.

Our long-term vision is to make managing glucose and energy simpler, more intuitive, and more human.
